description: This file defines the PasswordHash class which provides encapsulation for PHP's password_hash and password_verify functions, enabling password hashing and verification within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: PasswordHash
classes.description: A utility class that wraps PHP's password hashing and verification functions for secure password management.

methods.name: hash
methods.description: Generates a hashed password using bcrypt with a specified cost factor.

methods.name: verify
methods.description: Verifies a password against a given hash.
